label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a2 -> S1 trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (never at GO/D2, never after no reward). Its strongest activations come at D1 right after the agent chose a2, reached S1 through a rare transition, and got rewarded. That is the model-based evidence that S1 is good and the agent should switch to a1. This predicate covers 83% of top-quartile activations and 72% of activation mass on dev (P 0.44, R 0.50). The rest is a weak low-magnitude tail at D1 after other rewarded trials (mostly a2->S2 common rewarded, some a1->S2 rare rewarded). Rate is higher early in the episode (gone by trial 90+) and in episodes that started with S2 good. Adding the upcoming choice a1 (the switch) raises precision to 0.62 but halves recall, so it was not used. All variables are observed at D1, so no future variables are needed.
